# UX & Accessibility Requirements Quality Checklist: Abrir Arquivo Pelo Título

**Purpose**: Validate the clarity, completeness, accessibility, and ergonomic standards of requirements for title-triggered file selection and immediate playback
**Created**: 2026-11-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness & Scope Boundaries

- [x] CHK001 - Are the touch target dimensions and padding of `.meta-box` explicitly quantified against mobile touch target standards (minimum 48×48dp / WCAG 2.5.5)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 - Is the behavior during an empty or initial state (when no document title is loaded) clearly specified so that the clickable area does not collapse? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK003 - Are the visual feedback states (hover, `:active` scale 0.985, `:focus-visible` outline) explicitly defined with exact design tokens? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]

## Accessibility & Assistive Technologies (WCAG 2.1/2.2)

- [x] CHK004 - Does the specification require accessible ARIA attributes (`role="button"`, `tabindex="0"`, `aria-label`) for TalkBack and keyboard navigation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK005 - Is keyboard activation explicitly specified for both `Enter` and `Space` keys with standard button semantics? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK006 - Does the spec ensure that immediate auto-play does not clash with or drown out screen reader speech output (WCAG 1.4.2 Audio Control)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004]

## Interaction & State Transitions

- [x] CHK007 - Is the interaction state during rapid repeated taps (debounce / launch prevention while SAF is open) documented? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK008 - Are focus restoration requirements specified for when the user returns from the system file picker back to the webview? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
